setBoundary: Chronological order of three user actions across ShopRite, Walmart (Luvs diapers BOGO), and Ibotta (cashback redeemed for Amazon gift card).

items.why: User reports: “I used a Buy One Get One Free coupon on Luvs diapers at Walmart today.” (Walmart BOGO diaper coupon event).
User reports: “I just redeemed $12 cashback for a $10 Amazon gift card from Ibotta today.” (Ibotta redemption event).
User reports: “I signed up for [ShopRite’s] rewards program today…” (ShopRite rewards program signup event).
